scope: One private worker observer owns original context creation claims, bound actions, native recordings and shared screenshot scopes. The public automatic tracing gate remains disabled.

Recording reuse requires unchanged native options and an idle exact identity. Worker retirement retains late startup, chunk disposal and recording shutdown. Finalizer cleanup success, not settlement, returns capture admission.

Version11 startup separates setup from composed cleanup and returns the exact original initial chunk. Exact chunk retirement includes manual control, late unhanded archives and closed-owner cleanup; falsy cleanup rejection reasons remain failures.

Admission permits128 captures per original attempt,256 outstanding across attempts and128 live or retiring recordings. These are metadata limits supplementing existing byte allowances; no maximum resident-memory claim follows.

Browser and context closure share original artifact preparation and await all callbacks before native shutdown. The first close source wins, recursion is rejected, and direct browser closure seals traces while preserving the pinned omission of close-time screenshots.
verification: All three runtimes pass type/provenance, lifecycle, exact archive, finalizer, coordinator, screenshot and packed private integration checks. Controlled cases include256 pending worker captures and both browser/context close orders.

Actual pinned runner fixtures cover reused worker contexts, manual and separate-browser contexts, native snapshots/filmstrip, source references, mixed screenshots, all seven retention modes, two retries, expected failures, non-final/final skips, timeouts and SIGINT. Original outcomes and errors remain intact.
Every retained automatic archive passes CRC and the pinned trace loader; browser actions join original runner step IDs and titles. Native snapshot presence and source policy are checked.

The30-case screenshot differential and manual tracing differential pass on Bun and Node22/24. Bun also repeats actual coordinator scenarios with full Chrome. All frozen source, build, browser and driver hashes remain unchanged.

developmentFailures.condition: The first broader matrix found a screenshot regression after adding browser-close artifact preparation. The implementation now propagates context/browser source so direct browser close seals traces without adding screenshots absent from the pinned reference. All58 groups were rerun on the repaired frozen bytes.

The SIGINT experiment preserved the original outcome and runner journal but exposed a missing browser library archive when teardown used browser.close. Shared original owner-close preparation repairs the missing handoff.

Initial verifier incorrectly expected a trace from the pinned non-final fast-skip path. The corpus now distinguishes fast skips, all-skipped omitted workers and a final skipped test after a running predecessor.

reproduce: Build all four packages with pinned Bun, run tools/typecheck.mjs, and verify the applicable tools/record-*-provenance.mjs scripts with --check.

Run tools/test-trace-recording-lifecycle.mjs, tools/test-runner-trace-archives.mjs, tools/test-runner-trace-finalizer.mjs, tools/test-runner-artifact-coordinator.mjs, tools/test-runner-artifact-lifecycle.mjs, tools/test-runner-screenshots.mjs and tools/test-packed-runner-integration.mjs on Bun and Node22/24.

With explicit FLASHWRIGHT_BROWSER_PATH and FLASHWRIGHT_DRIVER_PATH, run tools/run-runner-artifact-coordinator-tests.mjs OUTPUT, then separate OUTPUT directories with --policies and --interruption on each runtime. Repeat these three on Bun with full Chrome.
Run tools/run-manual-trace-runner-tests.mjs and tools/run-runner-screenshot-tests.mjs on each runtime, plus tools/run-runner-trace-off-tests.mjs on Bun. Use external watchdogs.
limitations: Native browser cases reuse the accepted pre-API trace driver; no fresh combined native API/runner, Rust, full-core, Linux, package-manager or performance acceptance is claimed.

Public automatic runner integration, packed automatic consumer coverage and standalone API capture remain separate gates. The coordinator is private and automatic trace policies remain unsupported through the public runner.
No release, publication or fastest-framework claim. The overall drop-in and performance goal remains active.
